WITH monthly_region_sales AS (
  SELECT
    substr(ordered_at, 1, 7) AS month,
    region,
    SUM(amount) AS total_sales
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY month, region
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    region,
    total_sales,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS rn
  FROM monthly_region_sales
)
SELECT month, region, total_sales
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 2
ORDER BY month, rn;
